misuse.text: Don't say 'anytime' if you hate helping.

hook.text: Thanks so much for the ride!

publish.title: What does "anytime" mean?
publish.value: Anytime = You're welcome, ask again. Example: "Thanks for the ride! Anytime." (casual English, US).
